title: Conflict Protocol
concept: Full conflict pathway: regulation check, Warmth, Safety, Expression, Request, accountability order, Proof, Alignment.
whenToUse: Active conflict or recurring loops when Warmth is still possible (or after Pause returns you to regulation).
steps: Safety — Alliance not threatened this moment.
Expression — When X, felt Y; impact Z.
Accountability order — Impact → Help → Perspective last.
Proof if needed — behaviour + evidence + window.

phrases.text: I’m on your team, even though I’m frustrated.
Can we soften the room first?
I think we’re in pursue-withdraw — ten-minute pause?

working: Warmth confirmed received → Expression → one Request → Alignment booked. Loop interrupts without courtroom.
notWorking: Skip Warmth; cross-examine. Demand-withdraw locks. Fix: Warmth Signal bank + confirm received.
activity: Practice once on low-stakes friction with timer. Listener protects order.
